## QAC 380 Assignment 2 Descriptive Statistics and Plots


```{r assignment2, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# load packages
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Hmisc)
library(descr)

# call in the data set
penguins <- read_csv("penguins.csv")

# data structure
str(penguins)

# descriptives
penguins %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Bill_Length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Flipper_Length = mean(flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))

penguins %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Body_Mass = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE))

freq(penguins$species)

# scatterplot body mass by flipper length
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_
